name: sandbox-consumer
description: The minimal CONSUMER of the sandbox@1 seam kept as the interop proof: `sandbox guarded run` asks the loaded provider for a decision and runs the argv through the subprocess@1 seam ONLY when the decision allowed it - a deny runs nothing and is returned raw, an absent provider is refused fail-closed and reported as a gap.

config.description: This consumer has no configuration: the policy belongs to the provider, the decision is the provider's, and this plugin only applies it.
